author: Jizmo
quote: Gunplay music and environments look good however the story and character writing this time around just aint it. Jason is bland and just a forgettable character and Lucia is just flat out at times boring and truly a bad person being stuck to her the whole game is just exhausting.  Not to mention all the weird no gun areas in the game and just overall strange moments were freedom and choice are taken from you to show off "set pieces" Honestly just go play Gta V that game deserves the 99 rating not this.
